verdict.rationale: Earlier docs described a typed TypeScript SDK generated for each published server and a Vercel AI SDK integration. Smithery's own shutdown notice says "The Smithery CLI and SDKs" stopped working on October 31, 2026 and that current versions are deprecated. With the docs tree removed and no public repositories left, there are no working official SDKs to build against, so the story is not delivered.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
